title: The Great Fire read aloud, and music under every jaunt
items: The Great Fire jaunt in 1871 now has its narrator: every stop from the O'Leary barn to the rain is read aloud, for ages 11-13.

Every jaunt in every year now plays music. 1835 and 1871 have music of their own: the town, the river and the trades in 1835, the wooden city in 1871, and the Great Fire in three movements, from the barn to the ruins.
